# tests/test_clean_install_container.sh. Deliberately not the richer
# pihole_export.txt fixture the Python unit tests use: that fixture's
# allow-rule domains are all fake and would fail alderpointdns_compiler.py
# deploy()'s live post-deploy allowed-domain health check, which resolves
# the allow-listed domain for real. cloudflare.com is used here because
# deploy() special-cases it as the preferred allow-domain test target.

# blacklist.txt

# whitelist.txt
